legal.title: Privacy policy
legal.intro: How Brightside collects, uses and protects personal information.

body.html:
Who we are

Brightside Bookkeeping Ltd. (“Brightside”, “we”) provides bookkeeping, payroll and reporting services to small businesses. This policy explains what personal information we collect, why, and what rights you have. It applies to our website, our client portal and the services we provide.

Information we collect

We collect information you give us and information created while we provide our services.

Information you give us

  • Contact details: name, email address, phone number and business address.
  • Financial records you share for bookkeeping and payroll, including bank statements, invoices and employee pay details.
  • Messages you send us through forms, email or the client portal.

Information collected automatically

When you visit our website we record basic, anonymous analytics: pages viewed, the browser used and the approximate region. We do not use advertising trackers.

How we use your information

We use personal information only to provide the services you asked for, to meet our legal and regulatory obligations, to keep our systems secure and, if you agreed, to send you our newsletter. We never sell personal information.

Legal bases

We rely on the contract with you to provide our services, on legal obligation for record-keeping and tax reporting, on legitimate interests for security and service improvement, and on consent for marketing email. You can withdraw consent at any time.

Sharing with others

We share information only with the service providers we need to run our business, such as our accounting software provider, payroll processor and secure file storage, and with tax authorities when the law requires it. Every provider is bound by a written agreement. A current list is available on request from privacy@brightside.example.

International transfers

Some providers store data outside your country. Where they do, we use recognised safeguards such as standard contractual clauses, and we choose providers with strong security certifications.

How long we keep information

We keep financial records for seven years after the end of the financial year they relate to, as required by law. Marketing preferences are kept until you unsubscribe. Website analytics are deleted after fourteen months.

Security

Client files are encrypted in transit and at rest. Access is limited to the team members working on your account, protected by two-factor authentication and reviewed every quarter. See our security overview for details.

Your rights

You can ask for a copy of your personal information, ask us to correct it, ask us to delete it where we are not required to keep it, object to certain uses and ask us to transfer it to another provider. We reply within one month.

Cookies

Our website uses only cookies that are strictly necessary for it to work, such as remembering that you are signed in to the client portal. We do not use advertising or cross-site tracking cookies.

Changes to this policy

We review this policy at least once a year. When we make significant changes we will email current clients and update the date at the top of this page.

Contact us

Questions about privacy go to our data protection lead at privacy@brightside.example or by post to Brightside Bookkeeping Ltd., 12 Harbour Street, Portland. You also have the right to complain to your data protection authority.
